notes.title: Update 1.0.41
notes.content: Now player has more health in level 1, and slightly handicapped enemies in other levels.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hi! I updated the scoring system to match the Android version, as well as some other things:
 
- Minor graphics tweaks
- Few bug fixes
- New icon for the executable

notes.title: Balance update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hi,
I updated the overall difficulty balance of the game, so it is now easier to get one of the few available achievements.

notes.title: Update 1.0.21
notes.content:
- Changed the field of view in the second level to match other levels. Now helicopter flies higher.
- Fixed inactive enemy in level 2
- Fixed player's ability to destroy enemies off-screen.
- Fixed replay counter
- Fixed player's bullets range 
- More balancing fixes

Restart Steam client if your game wasn't updated.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Time for first game update:

- Player health increased by ~20%
- Added a few power-ups in levels
- 10 entries in the leaderboard

I updated the demo as well. Achievements are on the way!

notes.title: Update, Dec 5, 2017
notes.content:
It's time for an update. I replaced the gameplay footage and screenshots as the game is now in alpha stage. 
The camera FOV was changed to allow for flying enemies which did not fit on the screen previously. I also made 6 more enemy units and am now working on the levels. 
The release schedule did not change, I still expect Preventive Strike to be released in Q2 2018.

notes.title: Update, Oct 29, 2017
notes.content:
Hello,

I am TocanaDev and would like to tell you about the game's current state.
Preventive Strike is my first personal project. What you see here is a pre-alpha demo built with Unity 5 that currently has 1 level and 10 enemy units. It does not fully represent the final product. 
I'm working on it solo, while also having a regular job and dealing with other things that slow down the development process. However, if all goes well, I plan to have the game finished sometime in Spring 2018, and once I have more stuff to show, I will upload it here for everyone to see. 

Thank you for your interest and stay tuned for more gameplay and screenshots!
